verdict.rationale: Pylon's Support Agent uses runbooks and skills to handle multi-step workflows ('Give your agents manuals to execute complex procedures', 'Skills are reusable instructions... to handle specific workflows consistently') and the issue log shows 'outcomes and steps taken by the AI', while Assist/Background Agents 'investigate issues more deeply' rather than issuing single canned replies. However, no evidence explicitly documents the agent asking clarifying questions back to the customer as part of its flow. missing for 10: explicit documentation or example of the agent asking clarifying follow-up questions during a conversation, independent/hands-on proof of multi-turn troubleshooting behavior.
